授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Soil mechanics relates to the study of the engineering behavior of soils, which is needed in the design of civil engineering structures. Examples of these structures include embankments, fills and cuts, earth retaining walls, building foundations, bridges, dams, roads, railroads, ports and airports and so on. This subject is concerned primarily with the mechanical behavior of soils in general terms, which includes the definition of soils, basic properties of soils, flow of water in the ground, one-dimensional compression and consolidation, and shear strength and deformation of soils.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Classifications of soils, basic properties of soils, flow of water in the ground, effective stress, compression and consolidation, soil deformation and strength

(2) Knowledge of solid mechanics and continuum mechanics
